references.text: Concerns burning a city with fire that is under the ban, the same punishment mentioned in Joshua 7:15
Describes the penalty for breaking the covenant with the Lord, including being stoned and burned
Warns against bringing devoted things into the house, which leads to a curse
The fulfillment of judgment on Achan, who was burned with fire along with everything he owned
The warning about the ban and the consequences of taking anything that is devoted
Punishment by burning for serious sins in Israel
The expression 'committed an outrage in Israel' (נְבָלָה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל) is used in the same way
The same expression 'committed an outrage in Israel' for a grave sin
The expression 'outrage in Israel' is used regarding serious sins that require punishment
